oma_event_mapping.BeforeModel: UserPromptSubmit (trace-only; Qwen Code cannot rewrite model)

notes: Qwen Code has NO BeforeModel/AfterAgent events; OmA hooks were mapped to nearest Qwen Code events.
learn.js (AfterAgent) -> Stop: runs after each response, reads transcript, nudges /oma:learn on actionable sessions.
before-model-banner.js (BeforeModel) -> UserPromptSubmit: detects lane + writes model-router-last.json trace, but CANNOT switch the model (Qwen Code has no model-rewrite hook). Trace-only.
OMG_STATE_ROOT points at <project>/.qwen/state to keep OmA state consistent with the .qwen adaptation (scripts default to .omg/state).
BeforeModel model routing is non-functional in Qwen Code; remove the oma-model-router hook if the trace-only behavior is unwanted.
